free_tier.stated: free keyless API with no signup: 60 requests a minute per client; country, city, coordinates, network operator and a datacenter or VPN flag for any IPv4 or IPv6 address
free_tier.notes: no daily or monthly quota is stated; past the limit the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After.

retention.stated: not applicable: a lookup API; the service caches each address for an hour

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://www.unblockmaster.com/api/v1/ip/<ip> answers JSON for any IPv4 or IPv6 address and GET /api/v1/ip answers for the caller; CORS enabled; X-RateLimit-Limit and X-RateLimit-Remaining headers on every successful answer
chaining: Keyless country, city, network operator and datacenter or VPN flag at 60 lookups a minute per caller; the same API backs the vendor's VPN checker. Bulk path: none.

limits.value: 60 requests per minute per client; HTTP 429 rate_limited with Retry-After past it

binding_note: 60 requests a minute is the only published cap; no daily or monthly quota is stated.

identity_cost.detail: no API key and no signup

reliability_note: a best-effort service with no uptime guarantee; past 60 requests a minute it answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After; is_vpn is null when the lookup could not be completed
confidence_note: A keyless lookup of 8.8.8.8 was probed on 2026-11-02 and returned HTTP 200 with X-RateLimit-Limit 60; the limit was not exhausted.

evidence.proved: a lookup returns country, city, operator and a datacenter or VPN flag with no key and no signup
evidence.quote: Give it an IP address, get back its country, city, network operator and whether it belongs to a datacenter or VPN. No API key. No signup. No cost.

evidence.proved: the limit is 60 requests a minute per client
evidence.quote: The limit is 60 requests per minute per client.

evidence.proved: past the limit the API answers HTTP 429 with Retry-After
evidence.quote: | 429 | `rate_limited` | Over the limit. Honour the Retry-After header. |

evidence.proved: any IPv4 or IPv6 address can be looked up
evidence.quote: Looks up any IPv4 or IPv6 address.

evidence.proved: the page asks callers to cache results
evidence.quote: Cache results on your side where you can. Geolocation does not change minute to minute.

evidence.quote: We cache each address for an hour, so repeated lookups of the same IP are cheap for both of us.
